existing_source_facts.fact: Bridge::run captures the provider initial_ request during factory startup and assigns latest_=initial_ before serving actual demand.
The producer observes a demand change only when a captured provider request has an epoch different from latest_.epoch.
schedule excludes initial_.epoch and sends load/seek only for a newer latest_ epoch not already accepted; the inert initial capture does not eagerly load audio.
The conversion/publication refresh path also recognizes a changed provider epoch and discards the superseded local conversion state.

clarification.RequestObserved: Emit for an actual new provider demand after prime or seek when the producer observes the newer epoch and target. Do not emit for the inert factory-start initial_ capture. This refines the meaning of new provider epoch in the frozen contract without changing fields or API shape.
clarification.first_prime: The first actual prime produces one RequestObserved for its demanded epoch; there is no additional observation for the captured startup baseline and no factory default load.
clarification.same_epoch: Temporary underrun or repeated inspection of the same provider epoch does not create RequestObserved.
clarification.superseding_boundary: A queued old PacketAccepted may precede the producer observation of a newer demand. Old-epoch acceptance after that newer RequestObserved is invalid; the boundary is producer observation, not the time a UI seek is issued.
clarification.Full_scope: The frozen driver requires an actual accepted packet carrying fullObserved and a valid firstFullNs chronology. Its bounded scheduling opportunities do not establish performance, latency, readiness or thermal results.

unchanged_test_bindings.fact: First-demand uniqueObservation(RequestObserved) assertions are consistent with excluding the inert baseline.
The newer-demand boundary and existing no-eager-load oracle retain their original assertion source.

limits_retained: Completion endpoint/count field placement remains deferred because frozen text does not assign it unambiguously. Tests assert completion kinds/telemetry and exact accepted packet-end coverage, without inventing completion field bindings.
Nonempty PacketDiscarded coverage is conditional. Every observed old discard is validated; no scheduler sleep is treated as proof that a pending packet exists.
